theme: English wording and task interpretation shape visible explanations
boundary: The fictional speakers report different concerns, including the time needed to phrase an idea, interpreting lengthy prompts, uncertain response expectations and explaining patterns. These accounts cannot establish students' science understanding or English proficiency.

theme: Visual, peer and multilingual resources are described as helpful
boundary: Three imagined speakers describe using arrows, partner discussion or Korean notes before an English explanation. Their reports describe perceived resources, without observed performance, experimentally established benefits or evidence that every learner uses them.

theme: Sentence starters are described as helpful alongside control of evidence
boundary: This is a tentative single-excerpt teaching theme. Only P08 mentions sentence starters while seeking to select their own evidence. It should not be described as a recurrent pattern across participants.
